title: Raku Firing Workshops
source_quote: Our summer and fall dates for Raku and Naked Raku are now online! Join us to fire our raku kilns, handle the reduction chambers, and reveal your glowing, ​one-of-a-kind creations.
evidence_sentence: The homepage announces that summer and fall raku firing dates are available online for ongoing enrollment.
evidence_quote: Our summer and fall dates for Raku and Naked Raku are now online! Join us to fire our raku kilns, handle the reduction chambers, and reveal your glowing, ​one-of-a-kind creations.
summary: District Clay Center offers raku firings on rotating dates throughout summer and fall where potters fire their work and handle reduction chambers to reveal final results.
